scale.source: Income Tax Act Schedule 4 Part I para. 1: start of the 30 % band ('Exceeding Ushs. 4,920,000 | Ushs. 300,000 plus 30%'; ULII version 2024-12-23)
scale.basis: Income Tax Act Schedule 4 Part I para. 1: start of the 30 % band ('Exceeding Ushs. 4,920,000 | Ushs. 300,000 plus 30%'; ULII version 2024-12-23). A statutory band threshold, not an average wage: 1 'AW' in scanner output = this amount of annual income.

registry_correction: Registry 'Income Tax Act (Cap. 340); NSSF' corrected: the Revised Edition in force 2024-12-23 renumbers the rates as Schedule 4 (Part I individuals); year of income ends 30 June; resident rates 0/10/20/30 % (2.82 M / 4.02 M / 4.92 M) plus an additional 10 % above 120 M; NSSF employee 5 % of total wages, no ceiling, not deductible; local service tax under the Local Governments Act (rates not in the consolidated Act).
